scope_note: Reviewed bilingual terminology for the five collected ARRO pages. This is a Chinese segmenter for a small set of domain words plus a query expander, not a translation system and not a synonym dictionary. Every English term on the right was checked to occur in the collected pages (counts in README); candidates that occur zero times (timetable, waiting list, substitution, discontinuation, FAQ) were deliberately left out. Anything not listed here still falls back to CJK bigrams, which cannot match an English corpus. Expansion is opt-in: without --glossary retrieval is unchanged.
